subject: new water heater price
body: hi, we need to replace our water heater, its a 40 gallon tank about 12 yrs old. how much do you charge to put in a new one?? thx

evidence.anchor: Water heater replacement, 40-gallon tank, installed: $1,450

notes: Clean single-intent price question. The draft should quote $1,450 installed and nothing derived.

subject: guarantee?
body:
Do you guys guarantee your work? Last plumber we used just stopped answering when it started leaking again after a month. Wondering before I book anyone.

Marisol

evidence.anchor: Our workmanship is covered for 12 months

notes: Mentions a bad experience with another company; it is not a complaint about this business.

subject: faucet
body: What do you charge to instal a new kitchen faucit. I allready bought the faucet.

evidence.anchor: Faucet replacement, customer supplies the faucet: $165

notes: The customer supplies the fixture, which is what the flat price assumes.

subject: Toilet install cost
body:
Hello,

We bought a new toilet at the hardware store and would like to know the price for installing it, replacing the old one.

Regards,
Laszlo Moreau

evidence.anchor: Toilet replacement, customer supplies the toilet: $210

notes: Formal tone, one clear question.

subject: do you charge to come look
body: do you charge just to come out and look at something or only if you do the work

evidence.anchor: The standard call-out fee is $89.

notes: The draft should also say the fee is credited toward approved work, not that a visit is free.

subject: rate
body: whats your hourley rate

evidence.anchor: Labour is $115 per hour

notes: Very short. The draft should mention labour excludes parts and that billing is in 30-minute increments after the first hour.

subject: sewer line - roots?
body:
We think theres a tree root problem in our sewer line, toilets are slow and gurgle when the washer runs. How much is it to have a camera put down the line to look?

thanks, Dmitri

evidence.anchor: Camera inspection of a drain or sewer line: $175

notes: Gurgling and slow drains are symptoms, not an active sewage backup, so this is not an emergency.

subject: Plumbing inspection before closing
body:
Hi, we're buying a house and want the plumbing checked before we close. What does a full inspection cost and how long does it take? Do we get a report?

Fiona

evidence.anchor: Whole-home plumbing inspection with written summary: $225

notes: Three small questions (cost, duration, report) all covered by one line of the pricing document.

subject: flush
body: how much is it to flush a water heater? never been done in 8 years lol

evidence.anchor: Water heater flush: $129

notes: Plain price question.

subject: slab leak??
body: Do you guys handle slab leaks? I think we have one, the floor in our hallway feels warm in one spot and the water bill went way up

evidence.anchor: Repairing a leak in pipes under a concrete slab floor

notes: The documents say slab leak repair is by quote after leak detection. The draft must not quote a price.

subject: tankless?
body: do you instal tankles water heaters

evidence.anchor: Tankless installation is by quote

notes: Yes, by quote only. A draft that quotes the tank price would be wrong.

subject: water bill doubled
body: Our water bill has doubeld and I cant see a leak anywhere. Can you find a leak that's hidden behind a wall or under the floor?

evidence.anchor: Electronic detection to find the source of a hidden leak

notes: No price asked, so the draft need not quote one.

subject: main sewer line
body: Do you only clear the main sewer line or can you actually repair it if its broken? A plumber elsewhere said ours has a crack.

evidence.anchor: Repairing a damaged main sewer line once a camera inspection has shown the problem.

notes: Repair is by quote after a camera inspection.

subject: disposal
body: can you put in a garbage disposal if i buy it myself? what would you charge

evidence.anchor: Garbage disposal installation, customer supplies the unit: $185

notes: Can-you-do-it plus what-does-it-cost; the price is the main thing asked.

subject: cancelling
body: How much notice do I need to give if I have to cancle a visit? Not sure yet if ill be able to be home that day.

evidence.anchor: reschedule or cancel free of charge with at least 24 hours' notice

notes: A general policy question, not a cancellation of a specific booking.

subject: Payment
body: Hi, do you take checks or is it card only? Also do I pay when you're done or ahead of time?

evidence.anchor: We accept card, check and cash. Payment is due on completion of the visit.

notes: Terms, not a billing dispute, so policy_question.

subject: do i have to be home
body: Do I have to be there when the plumber comes? I work all day, my teenager will be home tho (17)

evidence.anchor: An adult aged 18 or over must be present during the visit.

notes: A 17-year-old does not meet the rule; the draft must not say the teenager is fine.

subject: paperwork for insurance
body:
A pipe burst in our kitchen last month and my insurance company wants documentation of the repair. Can you give me an invoice and photos? Do you deal with the insurance company yourselves?

Philippa Lund

evidence.anchor: can provide an itemised invoice and photos for an insurance claim

notes: The burst pipe is in the past, so it is not an emergency. The business does not file claims.

subject: sundays
body: are you open on sundays

evidence.anchor: The office is closed on Sunday

notes: The office is closed on Sunday but the emergency line is not; a good draft says both.

subject: Saltmarsh
body:
Hi, we live out in Saltmarsh. Do you come out that far and is there an extra charge for that?

Cecily

evidence.anchor: A travel fee of $40 applies to these areas

notes: Saltmarsh is an outer area with a travel fee.
